sentences.text: The applicant has filed this first application u/S.438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

T h e applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.527/2020 registered at Police Station- Dehat, District- Bhind (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC and Section 6(1) Nipekshako Ke Hiton Ka Sarankchan Adhiniyam.

entities.text: Nipekshako Ke Hiton Ka Sarankchan Adhiniyam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Prosecution case, in short, is that complainant Mahendra Kumar Joshi lodged a computerized complaint against present applicant accused who is Marketing Manager of GCA Marketing Company alleging that he is working as a labour.
Present applicant accused who is resident of his village told him and his other labour persons that he is Marketing Manager in aforesaid company.
Applicant accused assured him that the money will be deposited by the complainant, the two and half times of the said money with interest will be refunded to him after seven years.

Complainant Dileep Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184086665/
1 collected money from another persons and gave to present applicant accused according to his assurance that two and half times of principal amount will be refunded within seven years with interest.

entities.text: Complainant Dileep Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After maturity of the said amount, he along with other person connected to him had gone to receive the said money, present applicant accused denied the same and didn't return the money.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is permanent resident of District Bhind.
Applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
Under such circumstances, applicant prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
Learned State counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties at length and perused the case diary.

After hearing learned counsel for the applicant and going through the impugned order passed by the trial Court, this Court is of the view that trial Court has passed the impugned order after considering all the grounds raised by the applicant in this bail application, thus, trial Court has not committed any error in passing the impugned order.

Accordingly, this first application preferred under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
for grant of bail is hereby dismissed.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE Vijay Dileep Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184086665/
